main_text.p: Advocatio] Revocatio ad, Cic. Introvocatus ad, Amm. Accitus, us, Virg.

Advocatus] (1) generaliter causæ defensor] Patronus causarum. Actor causarum. Orator, Cic. Procurator litis, Paul. IC. Forensis homo, Quint. Qui linguam causis acuit, Hor. Et mitia sub judice bella movet, Lucan. Natus ad arma clamosi fori, Ovid.
(2) Advocatus accusatoris] Actor. Petitor. Accusator. Cic.
(3) Advocatus Rei] Defensor. Patronus. Ab reo, Cic.

(4) Advocatus in malam partem] Causidicus. Pugnaciter loquens, Fest. Proclamator, Cic. Rabula, Id. Latrator. Altercator, Quint. Ad lites (scil. homo) Propert. Prævaricator. Vocem in quæstum conferens : venalem linguam habens, Cic. Vitilitigator, Cato. Concinnator litium. Confarcinator causarum, Vlp. Togatus vulturius, Apul. Vendens jurgia fori, & verba locans, Sen. Loquendo pugnans, Ovid. Vendere verba solitus. Martial.

Adurere, leviter urere] Ignes cœlestes levi afflatu vestimenta adusserunt, Iul. Obseq. Amburere, Plaut. Præurere, Virg. Ignis degustavit tigna celeri flammâ. Suburere, Sueton. Glabrare sues ex tenuibus lignis factâ flammulâ, Col.
Aduri à Sole] Colorari sole, Cic. Nigrum colorem trahere, Ovid.

Adustus à Sole] Solatus, Plin. Præustus, Plin. Sole torridus. Cui discolor à sole cutis. Cui sole usta cutis, Plin. Decolor Indus, Ovid. Incoctus Maurus, Sisl. Exustus in sole, Celsi. Solibus perustus, Hor. Adustioris coloris homo ex recenti via, Liv.

Adustus] Afflatus incendio, Liv. Allambentibus flammis ereptus. Quint. Inustus vapore fulminis, Lucr. Levi afflatu ignis adustus, Iul. Obseq. Sudes obusta, Ovid. Ambesus flammis, Virg. Semiustus, Lucr. Semiustulatus, Cic. Semi ambustus, Suet. Ustulatus, Vitruv. Tosti parietes, stant defor-
